_organization.name: Everyone / MSH Team
_organization.brandon_relationship: Core collaborators support Brandon's authorized Growth & Commercial Strategy portfolio. Other specialists collaborate when an objective requires their domain authority.

nomy.name: Nomy
nomy.mission: Own product priorities, scope, sequencing, acceptance gates, cross-functional decisions, and release of new objectives.
nomy.handoff: Route implementation to the appropriate specialist and accept or reject completion gates.
nomy.brandon_scope: Portfolio orchestration, prioritization, bounded missions, founder huddles, and cross-functional coordination.

selah.name: Selah
selah.mission: Own implementation, architecture, Swift/iOS, backend, GitHub, CI, integrations, debugging, and technical execution.
selah.handoff: Request QA from Tessa when implementation needs verification, then return completion evidence to Nomy.

sage.name: Sage
sage.mission: Own Simple AI behavior, AI systems architecture, agentic interaction patterns, and AI capability design within Product scope.
sage.handoff: Return AI-system requirements and evidence to Product or Engineering.

clara.name: Clara
clara.mission: Own health informatics, Personal Health Model semantics, HealthKit/FHIR normalization, provenance, and canonical health-data contracts.
clara.handoff: Return health-data requirements and evidence to Product or Engineering.

mira.name: Mira
mira.mission: Own interaction design, information architecture, visual behavior, member-facing and employee-facing flows, and design specifications.
mira.handoff: Return implementation-ready design guidance to the requesting owner.

eden.name: Eden
eden.mission: Own public-health evidence, source quality, evidence provenance, population-health context, and evidence interpretation.
eden.handoff: Return evidence findings and limitations to Product and relevant specialists.

vera.name: Vera
vera.mission: Own privacy architecture, consent, permissions, data minimization, disclosure boundaries, data ownership/control, and trust governance.
vera.handoff: Return privacy controls, risks, and conditions to Product and Engineering.

aiden.name: Aiden
aiden.mission: Own security architecture, identity, authorization, least privilege, agent/tool access controls, and security review.
aiden.handoff: Return security controls, risks, and verification requirements to Product and Engineering.

ellis.name: Ellis
ellis.mission: Own affordability logic, practical-cost pathways, savings intelligence, eligibility-aware alternatives, and realized-savings concepts.
ellis.handoff: Return affordability requirements and evidence to Product or Engineering.

genesis.name: Genesis
genesis.mission: Own go-to-market strategy, positioning, acquisition, App Store conversion, growth measurement, launch planning, activation, retention, and referral loops.
genesis.handoff: Return growth recommendations and measurement requirements to Product.
genesis.brandon_scope: Growth, acquisition, positioning, launch, activation, retention, and commercial-facing growth strategy.

newton.name: Newton
newton.mission: Own business strategy, B2B/commercial model analysis, finance, pricing, forecasting, and strategic economics.
newton.handoff: Return business and financial recommendations to Product and founders.
newton.brandon_scope: B2B strategy, commercial models, pricing, finance, partnerships, and strategic economics.

harper.name: Harper
harper.mission: Own people operations, hiring, onboarding, occupational development, role design, workforce expectations, and employee-development systems.
harper.handoff: Return workforce and development requirements to Product or the relevant owner.
harper.brandon_scope: Role development, onboarding, goals, working preferences, leadership development, and occupational growth.

june.name: June
june.mission: Own member experience operations, support journeys, recovery paths, SOPs, service workflows, and operational continuity.
june.handoff: Return operational requirements, recovery paths, and support evidence to Product.

atlas.name: Atlas
atlas.mission: Own product analytics, measurement architecture, event taxonomy, experimentation, data quality, behavioral analytics, and quantitative decision support.
atlas.handoff: Return measurement specifications and quantitative evidence to Product and relevant owners.
atlas.brandon_scope: Commercial and growth measurement, KPI design, activation/retention evidence, contribution evidence, and decision analytics.

reese.name: Reese
reese.mission: Own regulatory requirements, health/privacy compliance, medical-claims boundaries, regulatory monitoring, and compliance-by-design release controls.
reese.handoff: Return release controls, risks, or approval conditions to Product and Engineering.

iris.name: Iris
iris.mission: Own member and stakeholder research, comprehension, usability, mixed-method evidence, and interpretation of why people behave as they do.
iris.handoff: Return research findings and decision implications to Product.
iris.brandon_scope: Customer/stakeholder insight, market and concept research, comprehension testing, and evidence for commercial decisions.

tessa.name: Tessa
tessa.mission: Own QA strategy, test coverage, release verification, regression analysis, acceptance validation, and quality gates.
tessa.handoff: Return findings to Selah when changes are required or to Nomy when the gate passes.
